Class StackElement

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.toolkit.element.StyledElement<StackElement>
dev.tamboui.toolkit.element.ContainerElement<StackElement>
dev.tamboui.toolkit.elements.StackElement
All Implemented Interfaces:
Styleable, Element
public final class StackElement extends ContainerElement<StackElement>
An overlapping layers layout element where children render on top of each other using a painter's algorithm (last child on top).

Essential for dialogs, popups, floating overlays, and any scenario where UI elements need to overlap.

All layout properties can be set via CSS or programmatically. Programmatic values override CSS values when both are set.

Supported CSS properties:

  • content-align — how children are aligned within the stack (default: stretch)
  • margin — margin around the stack layout
  • background — background color fill

Example usage: 

stack(
    text("Background").fill(),
    panel("Dialog", text("Content")).rounded()
).alignment(ContentAlignment.CENTER)

    • preferredSize

      public Size preferredSize(int availableWidth, int availableHeight, RenderContext context)
      Description copied from interface: Element
      Returns the preferred size of this element.

      The availableWidth/Height parameters allow elements to adapt their dimensions based on constraints. Use -1 for unconstrained.

      Common patterns:

      • Text elements: height depends on width (text wrapping)
      • Aspect-ratio elements: both dimensions interrelated
      • Fixed elements: ignore available dimensions

      Return value semantics:

      • Positive values = known size (use as constraint)
      • Zero = explicitly zero-sized (element should collapse)
      • Negative (-1) = unknown size (element should fill available space)
      Parameters:
      availableWidth - the available width in cells, or -1 if unconstrained
      availableHeight - the available height in cells, or -1 if unconstrained
      context - the render context for CSS resolution, may be null
      Returns:
      the preferred size
